Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live"

3. Designation — A fitted half-coupling, Type A of nominal dia 40 shall ba designated as: 

Fitted Helf-Coupling A 40 IS : 61 96 

4. General Requirements 

4.t Dimensions of the keye end keyweys shall be as given m IS 1 2048-1962 'Parallel keys end 
keyways', IS : 2291-1963 Tengentiel keys end keyweys*. 18:2292-1963 ' Taper keye and keywaya', 
and IS : 2293-1 963 ' Gib-heed keys and keyways '. 

4.2 The bolts used in fitted half-couplings shall be according to IS : 3640-1967 ' Hexagonal fit bolts'. 

4.3 The nuta ussd in fitted haH-eoupling shall be according to IS : 31 38 -1966 ' Hexegonel bolts and 
nuts ( M42 to Ml 60 ) ', snd 18: 1364-1967 ' Precision end semi-precision hexagon bolts, screws, 
nuts end lock nuts ( die range 6 to 39 mm ) < flnt rmrlslon 1 '.

4.4 The boh holts shall flftt be drilled end subsequently roomed, the coupling helves being in the tamo 
relative angular positions for both operations. 

4.5 Tha flsngss shall ba machlnad all over. 

S. Workmanship and Finish —Tha couplings shall ba free from cracks and burrs and the comers and 
edgee shell be rounded so es to evoid injury. 

L Marking —Shall be marked with type, nominal die d and manufacturer's name or trade-mark, 

M Certification Marking — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 

7. Preservative Coaling and Packing 

7.1 Each coupling shall be coated with a suitable sntl-corrostve and rust-proofing material and packed 
In e moisture proof paper. 

7 J Each coupling or a number of couplings shall be pecked in e certon bearing the type, stee and 
manufacturer's name or trade-mork.
